correctness.rationale: The current spiral-knot source gives \(D=(p-1)(q-1)\) and \(|a_1|=q\gamma_{p-1}+1\). Hence \(q-1\mid D\), \(q\mid m\), \(p=1+D/(q-1)\), and coprimality is required by the parameter convention. If \(m\) is prime and \(q\ge2\), then \(q=m\) immediately. For \(8_{21}\), \(D=4,m=3\) forces \((p,q)=(3,3)\), violating coprimality. The verifier accurately checks bounded instances but is unnecessary for the proof.
